Name: (AT) Tub o' Flowers Color Varieties
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
More color varieties of Tub o' Flowers to match your farm--now in Alternative Textures! Mix and match sixteen colors~
Huge thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Starwishgirl/about-me?gameId=1303]Starwishgirl [/url]for making the AT version, and [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/68147882-angelofstars/]AngelOfStars[/url] for the additional wood finishes!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1934]For the Content Patcher version, go here![/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25657]For Furniture Framework version, go here![/url]

There are two optional wood packs to expand with, under optional files--
[b]Burnt Sienna, [/b]to match my Burnt Sienna Craftables set
[b]AngelOfStars woods[/b]- comes in 4 colors: [b]Walnut, Spruce, Mahogany, and Ebony![/b]

Any more flower colors or wood finishes you'd like to see? Leave a comment on this mod, or send me a DM and I'll make an update!

[b]To install--[/b]
1. Install the latest versions of SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. Load up your game and enjoy! Use the Paint Bucket to apply your chosen colors-- see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures'[/url]﻿ instructions for further details.
